R441.note: snprintf prevents the overflow but silently truncates oversized names into a different badge string instead of rejecting/reporting - exactly the 'truncating names silently' pattern the case flags as the wrong answer; the write-up does disclose the truncation (misjudging it as acceptable), which is why this isn't a 0.

R443.note: @PreAuthorize with an ownership-checking security bean runs before service.delete() is invoked, avoiding the after-the-fact-check trap.

R446.note: Escaping of * ( ) \\ correctly closes the injection, but the space case maps to \\00 - the RFC 4515 escape for a NUL byte, not for space - so any legitimate cn search containing a space (e.g. a two-word name) silently fails to match; not disclosed.

R447.note: offset<=capacity then length<=capacity-offset in that order, exactly the prescribed check avoiding unsigned underflow.
